faq.question: Q1. What is the IOB Advisor – Customer Service Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual recruitment process conducted by Indian Overseas Bank to engage one retired bank officer as Advisor – Customer Service at the Central Office in Chennai.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 unreserved vacancy available for the Advisor – Customer Service post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and payment of intimation charges is 09.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduation or Post-Graduation degree with a minimum of 20 years of experience in Public Sector Banks and wide exposure in customer service functions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is below 65 years as of 01.09.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable intimation charge is Rs. 1000/- inclusive of GST, payable through online mode.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the official website www.iob.bank.in under the "Careers" section before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a personal interview carrying an aggregate of 100 marks.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly remuneration for this post?
faq.answer: The appointed candidate will receive Rs. 50,000/- per month, subject to relevant TDS deduction.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on a contract basis for a period of three years and does not constitute regular employment in the bank.
